{{Quote|Humbah! Looganah! Humbah! Looganah! Disjenck! Now shall the demon of war, Malmourral, be sated.|[[Peteen/Legends|Peteen]]|<ref name="The Disappeared, Part I">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part I}}</ref>}}
The '''Frangawl sacrificial ceremony''' was a ritual used by the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] to drain the [[The Force/Legends|Force-essence]] from their victim in the [[Bardottan Sphere|living sphere]].
